## What this is

Grant Radar reads every NIH Guide notice each week, extracts the parts that matter (purpose, eligibility, budget, key dates, do's and don'ts), and presents them so a researcher can scan a week's notices in minutes instead of hours.

## What to expect here

- A ranked list of this week's notices, with TL;DR cards.
- Filter by IC, mechanism, topic, and career stage.
- Click through to a full structured view of any notice.
- Save a profile (in your browser, no account) so the feed re-ranks for you.

See [About](about.qmd) for methodology and limitations.
